ADOMs settings

Create, edit, deactivate and delete the ADOMs (product workspaces) — name, logo, banner, active and placeholder flags, and the capability switches that decide which shared features each workspace offers.

👤 ForAdministratorAdvanced user
🔑 Permissionsusers.manage
📍 WhereSettings → Fleet & Devices → ADOMs (URL /settings/#tab-adoms)

What is it?#

The ADOMs tab is the catalog of product workspaces (FortiWeb, FortiADC, FortiAnalyzer, FortiAuthenticator, Global …). It is stored in the database, not in code: each ADOM has a logo, names, a default banner, an Active flag, a Placeholder flag and five capability switches. The concept is explained in ADOMs and products.

What does it do?#

  • Edits every existing ADOM in its own card and saves it with Save <name>.
  • Creates new ADOMs (Add a new ADOM → Create ADOM).
  • Deletes ADOMs that are not protected.
  • Deactivating an ADOM removes it from the product selector and its routes return 404 or redirect.
  • Capabilities — Banner, API Tokens, Firmware, Naming, Regex — decide which shared subsystems pick the ADOM up automatically.

Requirements#

  • users.manage.

Permissions#

🔑Permission

Create, update and delete check users.manage inside the view and return 403 without it.

How to use#

Edit an ADOM#

  1. Open Settings → Fleet & Devices → ADOMs.
  2. In the ADOM's card change Name, Title, Order, Tagline, Default banner, Description, the Active / Placeholder (scaffold only) switches and the Capabilities; optionally upload a new logo.
  3. Click Save <name> — "ADOM 'fortiweb' updated."

Create an ADOM#

  1. In Add a new ADOM, enter Key (required) and the other fields.
  2. Click Create ADOM — "ADOM 'fortimail' created." The new ADOM is placed last in the order.

Delete an ADOM#

  1. Click Delete in the ADOM's card.
  2. Confirm "Delete ADOM <key>? This cannot be undone."
  3. The ADOM is removed — "ADOM '…' deleted."

ℹ️Note

Changed in 2.11.0: deleting an ADOM asks for confirmation again; before, the prompt was blocked by the console's Content Security Policy and the ADOM was deleted on the first click.

Configuration#

Field Description Required Example
Key Lowercase identifier used in URLs: letters, digits, -, _; 2–64 characters, starting with a letter. Cannot be changed after creation. Yes (create) fortimail
Name Display name, max 128 characters. Defaults to the key on create. No FortiMail
Title Max 128 characters; blank saves SATOM. No SATOM
Order Sort position (whole number). New ADOMs get the next number. No 5
Tagline Max 200 characters. No Next-Gen Firewall
Default banner Banner template shown for this ADOM unless a user picks their own on their profile page. No Slate
Description Free text. No —
Active Default on for new ADOMs. Off = hidden everywhere; routes 404/redirect. No on
Placeholder (scaffold only) A workspace listed without product pages behind it. Default on for new ADOMs. No on
Capabilities Banner (default on for new), API Tokens, Firmware, Naming, Regex. No Banner
Logo PNG, JPG, WEBP or GIF (resized to fit 256 px) or SVG (max 512 KB, scripts and event handlers stripped). No fortimail.svg

Example#

🧪Example — Prepare a workspace for a new product

Create key fortimail, Name FortiMail, Tagline Email Security, keep Active and Placeholder on, tick Banner and Naming. The ADOM appears in the product selector as a placeholder; Naming patterns and banners already work for it.

Result#

  • Changes take effect immediately (the ADOM registry cache is refreshed); audit entries settings.adom.create, settings.adom.update, settings.adom.delete.
  • Logos are written to the application's static image folder as adom-<key>-mark.png or .svg.

Troubleshooting#

"Invalid ADOM key — use lowercase letters, digits, - and _ (2-64 chars, starting with a letter)."#

Solution — correct the key; uppercase is converted to lowercase automatically.

"An ADOM with key '…' already exists."#

Solution — pick another key or edit the existing card.

"The '…' ADOM is a core product and cannot be deleted — deactivate it instead."#

Possible causes — global, fortiweb and fortiadc are wired into URL scoping.

Solution — switch Active off instead.

"The '…' ADOM still has N registered appliance(s) and cannot be deleted — move or de-register them first, or deactivate the ADOM instead."#

Possible causes — an appliance's kind is its ADOM key; deleting the ADOM would orphan those devices.

Solution — remove or re-register the appliances, or deactivate the ADOM.

"Unsupported logo type (use PNG, JPG, WEBP, GIF or SVG)." / "SVG too large (max 512 KB)." / "Not a valid SVG file."#

Solution — upload a supported, smaller or valid file. Nothing else in the form is saved when the logo is rejected.

Advanced#

Advanced Protection rules
  • Undeletable: the three core keys, plus any ADOM that still owns registered appliances (checked at delete time). The Delete button is still shown for the latter; the server refuses.
  • Deactivating an ADOM hides it but keeps its data; SoT retention rules written for it keep applying (see Configuration SoT).
